dialogues.speaker: Sirafi
dialogues.text: Even if you've never heard of that name, you should know the enormous palace in northern Sumeru, right?

dialogues.speaker: Sirafi
dialogues.text: That's right, that's the Palace of Alcazarzaray. I work for the owner.

dialogues.speaker: Sirafi
dialogues.text: Any product she touched carries a higher price, even if it couldn't be more ordinary!
